mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact finite-field rank formula and the all-order limiting generating series for phase-averaged squared secular coefficients of symplectic Fourier unitaries
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Integers, rational numbers, finite fields F_3 and F_5, and exact cyclotomic arithmetic; no floating approximation
mathematics.conventions: P_sigma[i,sigma(i)]=1; A_sigma=P_sigma-P_sigma^T; symplectic Fourier S_xy=N^(-1/2) omega^Omega(x,y); c_N,k=E|e_k(DS)|^2

bounds.rank_polynomials: p=3,5; k=0..7; conjugacy classes for sigma, all tau
bounds.negative_control: Replacing finite-field ranks by zero must fail at k=3

non_claims: The finite run is not an asymptotic proof; the separate note supplies the proof
Global secular coefficients do not identify the two-channel transmission law
No BGS proof, admissible transmission counterexample, literature priority, or formal verification
